subject: Subscripts
notes: GAP -> CONFORMS (kb/Work PB681). Rule text validated: cite.py --check 8.4.2.3.3 "Each table element reference shall be subscripted except when such reference appears" -> OK 5). An OMITTED subscript list on a table element is COBOL2270 at all three identifier entries (Resolve, ResolveForItem for a condition-name's conditional variable, ResolveForAddressOf); before, each returned an unreported null (or the first occurrence's address) and MOVE E TO B aborted at run time. The seven exception contexts a)-g) never reach the screen: the SEARCH subject resolves through ResolveTableOperand, the SORT table subject and keys through SortBinder's own data-description walk, REDEFINES / OCCURS KEY / SUM through the data binder; the screen's summary records that boundary.
